name: David McAllister - Après le § 15 - Am 13
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 15e. Recalls that Israel possesses nuclear weapons and refuses to allow any inspections or provide transparency; condemns the double standards of the United States, the Commission and the EU Member States in addressing nuclear proliferation, as reflected in the sanctions imposed on Iran while no comparable measures are being taken against Israel;
